subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a Gateway/provider-backed editable dictation workflow in the current Control UI composer, using `operator.write` and `tools.media.audio` for transcription?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing microphone workflow and browser-to-Gateway audio method, so implementation correctness alone cannot decide whether the product and security boundary belongs in core Control UI now.

options.title: Sponsor after port and proof
options.body: Keep this PR or a replacement path alive, but require a current-main port, accessibility/docs fixes, and redacted real recording-to-draft proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to the broad voice tracker
options.body: Keep the paired issue open but pause this branch until maintainers settle the broader WebChat STT/TTS direction.

options.title: Close and request a fresh PR
options.body: Close this branch if maintainers prefer a new, narrower implementation against the current chat page architecture.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after port and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR or a replacement path alive, but require a current-main port, accessibility/docs fixes, and redacted real recording-to-draft proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal on the earlier Gateway-backed dictation implementation and related WebChat voice boundary.
